Agenda
Item 1
Annual Performance Goal Setting for Executive Team

The Annual Performance Goal Setting for Executive Team was a review of the company's compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA). The committee reviewed the company's safety record and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To approve for values: RESOLVED, that the IT Steering Committee adopts the revised Annual Performance Goal Setting for Executive Team policy, which shall supersede all prior policies on this matter, effective immediately.

Moved: Niall Aliyu  •  Seconded: Mae Mitra
Vote: 5 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment

The Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment was a review of the company's compliance with antitrust laws. The committee reviewed the company's competitive practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 3
Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review

The committee considered the {item_title}, a proposal to adopt a new policy on insider trading. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.
